sql:
SELECT pl.period, 
       SUM(pl.qty * pl.contract_unit_price) / SUM(pl.qty) AS weighted_avg_contract_price_cad,
       SUM(pl.amount_cad) / SUM(pl.qty) AS avg_actual_cost_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
WHERE pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY pl.period
ORDER BY pl.period
